title: Two-Orbit Polytopes
summary: Abstract polytopes are combinatorial structures with distinctive geometric, algebraic, or topological characteristics, that generalize (the face lattice of) traditional polyhedra, polytopes or tessellations. Most research has focused on abstract polytopes with the highest possible symmetry, in particular those that are regular or chiral. In this paper we study two-orbit polytopes, that is, abstract polytopes whose automorphism groups have exactly two orbits on flags.
